cause: NEGATIVES_ROOT_CAUSE_V1: every economy/amortisation/transfer atom failed while every invariance/detection atom held; two mechanism laws (RC1 no-free-lunch corner sampling, RC2 capital-cost floor) plus one reading law (RC3 measurement-path failure) explain all of them; unconditional economy claims are posed against laws that forbid them, and the registry had no axis on which the surviving conditional inequality (HSG-03 / #323 HC-7) could flip
does_not_reopen: no merged verdict, frozen world, seed, terminal or claim ceiling is altered by this amendment; it adds types, axes and claim-shape rules for FUTURE freezes and for re-reading existing terminals as boundary cases

capital_typology.cause: #323 HC-1 (solution capital must not stand in for search capital) unified with the measured economy negatives; each type carries its own payback law and admissible claim shape

SOLUTION_STRUCTURAL.payback_law: sound build costs >= one direct concrete pass (construction floor); exact answering refines toward discrete (RV_B1: 81.2% states discrete, marginal 12.966 vs 11.738 direct)
admissible_claims: delta-relaxed frontier: total_cost(delta) < total_cost_direct at some measured (delta, Q, rho) corner
inadmissible_claims: unconditional exact-economy wins (D20/RV_B1 refuted the shape, not just the instance)

SOLUTION_EPISODIC.examples: cached exact answers, provenance substitution, recorded support reuse
SOLUTION_EPISODIC.payback_law: pays iff recompute_depth > bookkeeping_constant; D19 ratio 1.07 at depth=one shallow BFS is the shallow boundary, not the law
admissible_claims: substitution_ratio(recompute_depth) frontier with crossover depth d*

SOLUTION_DECLARATIVE.examples: libraries, lemmas, macros, typed operators with applicability contracts (#323 HC-6: DISTINGUISH/REFINE/VERIFY transfer; REDUCE fails where its semantic precondition is absent)
SOLUTION_DECLARATIVE.payback_law: pays iff cross-ecology recurrence sigma > sigma* = acquisition_cost / (Q x savings_per_recurrence); at sigma ~ 0 the loss is structural (no-free-lunch), not a defect
admissible_claims: typed-operator transfer WITH frozen applicability contract and its hostile (REDUCE-class) control

SEARCH.examples: representation, decomposition, proposal distribution, retrieval, verification strategy, meta-control
SEARCH.payback_law: not yet measured anywhere in the programme; D27 prospectively frozen future-cognition signature ABSENT (related 0.0135 vs unrelated 0.0194)
admissible_claims: rank_H(t+1)(m*) < rank_H(t)(m*) with m* not present in history (#323 HDI-15 behavioural receipt)
SEARCH.note: this is the developmental capital; solution-capital positives may never be reported as development

ECOLOGICAL.examples: learned expectations about which structures recur and where transfer is worthwhile
ECOLOGICAL.payback_law: value only under the same ecology axes it was learned on (RC1); admissible claim shape is ecology-indexed

ASSAY.examples: learned ability to detect whether an apparent improvement is real
ASSAY.payback_law: governed by RC3: every measurement path must survive hostile attack in alarm AND no-alarm directions before its negatives are read

ecology_axes.cause: RC1: all measurements ran at the no-free-lunch corner (rho=1, sigma~0, shallow d) by construction of the world generators

mandatory_in_freeze.rho: novel-region fraction of the query stream (fraction of queries falling outside any reusable capital's support)
mandatory_in_freeze.sigma: cross-world/cross-ecology subproblem recurrence rate (fraction of future-world structure that maps onto developmental-history structure under the frozen structural-relatedness relation)
mandatory_in_freeze.d: solution depth (recompute depth for episodic; decomposition depth for structural)
mandatory_in_freeze.delta: answer-relaxation dial for structural capital (delta=0 exact; delta>0 buys coarse blocks lawfully)

ecology_axes.generator_obligation: world-family generators must be able to PLANT recurrence at controlled (rho, sigma) — a generator that can only emit one-off puzzles measures only the NFL corner and its economy terminals must say so
ecology_axes.structural_relatedness: per #323 HC-3/DEV-CAL-1: shared minimal decomposition, shared operator/support structure, or a known valid transport map; a semantic family label is NEVER a substitute

deprecated_shapes: unconditional economy win at a single unmeasured-ecology corner
binary wins/loses reported without the ecology corner coordinates
solution-capital positive reported as developmental/search-capital improvement
admissible_shapes: frontier endpoint: Q*(rho,sigma,d,delta), rho*, sigma*, delta* — the crossover threshold with the swept grid attached
boundary-case statement: a prior negative re-read as the delta=0 or rho=1 or sigma=0 boundary of a measured family
conditional inequality (HSG-03 surviving form / #323 HC-7): future_savings > acquisition + maintenance + revision, evaluated ON MEASURED axes

predictions_registered.rho_star_derivation: two independent derivations from published RV_B1 numbers: linear fit of the amortisation table (direct marginal ~416 ops/query vs incremental ~813 -> rho* ~ 0.512) and the terminal's own steady-state marginals (11.738/12.966 ~ 0.905); D29 measures which (or neither) holds
predictions_registered.sign_flip_prediction: RV-8 already exhibits the prediction: same library positive (~55% cheaper) on a constructed low-rho stream, negative (~40.5% costlier) on natural high-rho draws
